title: Stack
summary: The standard SwiftUI VStack with its spacing taken from the Monarch space scale. Monarch ships nothing.
whenToUse: For any column of views with even gaps. Pass theme.spacing.space2, space4 and so on as the spacing, never a number.
whenNotToUse: For a row use HStack, and for a row that wraps use MonarchFlowLayout (see inline). For many rows that scroll use LazyVStack in a ScrollView, or List.
api: VStack(alignment: HorizontalAlignment = .center, spacing: CGFloat? = nil, content: () -> Content)
appearance: A stack draws nothing. Its children look the same in every theme as they do outside it.
platformNotes: The web Stack has gap, align, justify, dividers and an element name. On iOS gap is the spacing argument with a value from theme.spacing, align is the alignment argument (leading, center, trailing), and justify is a Spacer or a frame with an alignment. dividers is a MonarchDivider written between the children. Stretching children to the full width is frame(maxWidth: .infinity) on each child. Android uses Column with Arrangement.spacedBy in the same way.
accessibility: A stack adds no accessibility element; children keep their own and are read from top to bottom.
Leading and trailing alignment follow the layout direction.
edgeCases: Without a spacing argument SwiftUI picks a default that differs between kinds of views; always pass one from the scale.
A VStack is as wide as its widest child. Add frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading) to fill the width.
VStack builds all its children at once; use LazyVStack for long scrolling content.

examples.title: Default spacing
examples.template:
VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.space4) {
    Text({{boxes.0}})
        .monarchTextStyle(.bodySmall)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .padding(theme.spacing.space3)
        .background(theme.colors.bgMuted, in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: theme.radius.md))
    Text({{boxes.1}})
        .monarchTextStyle(.bodySmall)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .padding(theme.spacing.space3)
        .background(theme.colors.bgMuted, in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: theme.radius.md))
    Text({{boxes.2}})
        .monarchTextStyle(.bodySmall)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .padding(theme.spacing.space3)
        .background(theme.colors.bgMuted, in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: theme.radius.md))
}
.frame(maxWidth: 360)

examples.title: With dividers between the children
examples.code:
VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.space3) {
    Text("Profile").monarchTextStyle(.body)
    MonarchDivider()
    Text("Billing").monarchTextStyle(.body)
    MonarchDivider()
    Text("Members").monarchTextStyle(.body)
}
